note.text:
Hi Dana,

Attached is the clean copy of the Master Services Agreement, ready for countersignature. We corrected a few typographical errors. We updated our notice address in Section 14. We tidied the wording of the invoice dispute sentence without changing its meaning. No commercial or legal terms were changed. Payment terms remain net thirty days. The limitation of liability is unchanged. The annual subscription fee is unchanged.

Could you sign and return it by Friday so we can meet our go-live date?

Thanks,
Priya Raman
Procurement, Brightwater Logistics

ablation.text: 1 faithful rewording(s) would be sent to negotiation. The cover note would be taken at its word: 3 false statement(s) would not be caught, and this review would read “changes to resolve” instead of “do not sign”.
4 of 4 change(s) would rest on one reading of the clause instead of two. Nothing would check that the two files are versions of the same agreement, and there would be no paired copies of the PDFs.
4 change(s) would reach the reviewer with no playbook answer attached; 1 passage(s) written for a different deal size would be candidates to quote.

endpoints.name: Verify
endpoints.effect: Reads meaning twice. Each changed sentence against the other version: a spelling fix that changes meaning becomes a change, a faithful rewording is cleared. Each statement of the cover note: a contradicted one blocks signing.

endpoints.name: Compare
endpoints.effect: Reads each clause in question as sent against as returned: a conflict confirms a change or overrules a spelling fix, and vetoes clearing a rewording. On the two whole PDFs: checks they are versions of one agreement and returns the paired, marked copies.

endpoints.name: Rerank
endpoints.effect: Picks the playbook passages for each change and skips those for other deal sizes; none found means Legal.

endpoints.name: Decide
endpoints.effect: Routes each change using the passages Rerank kept; low confidence means a person decides.

endpoints.name: Extract
endpoints.effect: Reads the key terms of both versions for the side-by-side table and the deal size given to Rerank.

endpoints.name: Guard
endpoints.effect: Flags text addressed to an AI reviewer; a hit blocks signing.
